'''Ikwo''' is an [[Igboid languages|Igboid language]] spoken in [[Ebonyi State|Ebonyi state]] in [[Nigeria]]. It forms a [[dialect cluster]] with closely related [[izii language|Izii]], [[Ezza language|Ezza]], and [[Mgbo language|Mgbo]], though they are only marginally mutually intelligible.
